deletion_trials.reason: Removing this replacement leaves the original false assertion |a+b|=sqrt(a^2+b^2), so the identified inference is not repaired.

reason: For every real x, |x|=sqrt(x^2), since x^2 is nonnegative and sqrt(x^2) is the nonnegative number having square x^2. Taking x=a+b yields the replacement identity. The patch changes only the erroneous equality at node 1; it neither changes the stated real-number assumptions nor the triangle-inequality theorem or its elementary-algebra domain. There are no unrelated branches.
